messages:
Anna (Partnerships): Quick pulse — can we align on vendor roadmap and announcement windows for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi? Need a tentative public comms plan and marketplace certification gating by end of next quarter.
Raj (HW Eng): Driver/firmware timelines look okay for H100 -> GA target mid-next-quarter, H200 still TBD from vendor (expect EOM). MI300 has SR-compat work that adds ~3 wks. Gaudi drivers stable but infra capacity limited.
Marie (Product): Marketplace listing needs image signing + perf profile. How much runway for the perf validation?
Raj (HW Eng): For perf validation we need ~2 full perf runs + stability tests per model family. Each run ~48h on our CI fixtures. So plan ~10 business days optimism.
Nate (Sales): Heads up — we have two mid-market pilots asking specifically for H200 availability in region us-west-2. If H200 slips we need fallback messaging and pricing guidance.
Tess (PR): For joint announcements, vendors require embargo windows and a draft 7 days prior. We should coordinate PR assets (quotes, benchmarks, logos) sooner. Who owns the benchmark deck?
Anna (Partnerships): @Raj to confirm perf ETA; @Marie to own marketplace artifact checklist; @Tess to own press timeline. I'll coordinate vendor sync calls. Action: get a single-source deck by next Tue.
Raj (HW Eng): Ack. I'll surface any driver-blocking firmware versions. Also flag: kernel module v1.12 on our infra breaks multi-gpu scheduling for some model configs — workaround in test branch:
```
# quick test command
BOARD=mi300 ./run_infer.sh --batch 8 --seq 2048
```
We need to validate after vendor kernel patch.
lab-ci-bot: nightly-perf-suite: started 1881237900, ETA ~ 36h, artifacts at https://ci.internal/runs/9887 (private).
Marie (Product): Marketplace certification items: signed image, perf profile CSV, model card, security attestation, and release manifest. I'll draft checklist and post tomorrow.
Nate (Sales): For go-to-market, recommend two announcement waves: soft beta to partners + select customers (1 week), then public marketplace listing (2-3 weeks later). Need to confirm vendor embargo windows.
Tess (PR): Also check vendor marketing calendars — some vendors prefer vendor-first announcement. We should request preferred order in the vendor sync.
Anna (Partnerships): Proposed tentative timeline:
- Week 0: vendor sync, check embargo & driver ETAs
- Week 1: internal perf runs + draft benchmark deck
- Week 2: finalize artifacts, send to vendor for quote/approval
- Week 3: soft beta w/ partners
- Week 5: public marketplace listing + joint PR
Is everyone comfortable with that cadence?
Raj (HW Eng): Feels tight if MI300 firmware takes +3 wks, but doable with parallel workstreams. I'll add an explicit contingency step to swap to Gaudi/H100 variants if H200/MI300 delayed.
Marie (Product): Sounds good. Please include CC for compliance team on the release manifest.
Nate (Sales): I'll prepare enablement one-pager and earmark demo slots for partner pilot customers.
Tess (PR): I'll draft the PR timeline and sample embargo language. Will need final quotes by Week 2 EOD.
Anna (Partnerships): Great. I'll book a 30m vendor-coordination call tomorrow 10am PT and share calendar invites. If you have any hard constraints (press deadlines, pilot cutoffs), reply here.
Raj (HW Eng): Blocking items to call out on the sync: firmware branch merge window, perf infra capacity (need extra B200 slot), and driver validation matrix.
Nate (Sales): Pilot cutoff — customers expect hardware availability by the end of Month+1 or we push to later pilots.
Tess (PR): Also request embargo flexibility of +/- 2 days from vendor in case of last-minute fixes.
Anna (Partnerships): Noted. Meeting invite sent. Thanks everyone — will post meeting notes and owners after call. :thumbsup:
